inputs_are: illustrative numbers typed for the measurement, not anyone's product

response.method: Value-Based Price Anchor (ICER/QALY willingness-to-pay threshold inversion)
response.note: Public registers and published literature. A missing row is a gap. Price figures on finder tools are hypotheses, not invoices.
response.citation: Neumann, P.J., Cohen, J.T., & Weinstein, M.C. (2014). Updating Cost-Effectiveness -- The Curious Resilience of the $50,000-per-QALY Threshold. NEJM, 371(9), 796-797. DOI:10.1056/NEJMp1405158; NICE (2022). NICE health technology evaluations: the manual.
